title: inspect_ia_agents recette -- Ed25519-signed policy bundle
description: The Risk Scoring Engine emits a policy bundle (per-agent decisions + policy version) signed with Ed25519 before it reaches the control plane. The recette verifies SHAPE + SIGNATURE; it does not produce production bundles. The signature covers the canonical JSON of {policy_version, decisions} (sort_keys, compact separators, utf-8).

policy_version.description: Version of the policy the decisions were computed under (replay-relevant, I4).

public_key.description: Ed25519 public key, hex-encoded (32 bytes -> 64 hex chars).

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical payload, hex-encoded (64 bytes -> 128 hex chars).
